simple.meaning: נִמְרִים (Nimrîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nimrim , a place East of the Jordan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נִמְרִים (H5249) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 15:6, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִמְרִים (H5249) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נִמְרִים (H5249) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נִמְרִים (Nimrîym) / H5249 is traced through Isaiah 15:6, Jeremiah 48:34 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
